description.narrative: The project is implemented in Palestine. The main outcome areas it contributes to are democracy and human rights, workers rights, peace and dialogue and gender equality. The main rights holders are workers, unionists, union representatives and trade unions. Through fostering alliance and joint advocacy among democratic unions, legal consultations, training, awareness, advocacy the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between Democracy and Workers Rights Center and the Palme Center. DWRC is a workers learning center conducting training, research, policy formulation, legal advice, advocacy and campaigning with national, regional and international alliance that they are part of. Their main areas of concern include social and economic justice and supporting social movements for equality and rights.Other Donors to the OrganisationEU, Olof Palme International Center, Fondation des Droits de lHomme au Travail, UNISON Int. Development Fund, Misereor Catholic Central Agency for Development Aid, the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs and MPDL CUPE. No other donor to this specific project.Project ObjectiveTo empower the Palestinian trade union movement, and develop strategies for defending workers rights, promoting gender equality and spreading a democratic culture.Actor groupsDecision makers: Government Actors working in cooperation: Trade unions, Ministry of Labour, (particularly labour inspectors and labour relations staff), the Ministries of Womens Affairs and Local Authorities, the Palestinian Cabinet, the PA Employees Bureau Employers and The National Committee for Womens Employment (NCWE) Right Holders: Male and female workers, particularly most vulnerable and marginalized (including PWDs), Male and female unionists, union representatives and trade unions
